verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Terraform has workspaces that carry their own state and variables. Docs say state is per workspace [docs-20], HCP Terraform workspaces support variables, tags and runs [docs-56, docs-65], and `-var-file` lets you supply per-environment inputs [docs-46]. A community user reports managing dev/qa/prod infra with Terraform [comm-1], but no first-party doc explicitly describes using workspaces or stacks to separate dev, staging and prod. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the per-environment workspace/stack pattern, CLI `terraform workspace` command docs, guidance on isolating environment-specific config and secrets.
